stated: The Conservative Party will match fund 100 criminal law pupillages to speed up justice for victims and will continue to ensure access to justice through legal aid provision, also expanding legal aid at inquests related to major incidents.

source.quote: We will match fund 100 criminal law pupillages to speed up justice for victims and will continue to ensure access to justice through legal aid provision. We will expand the provision of legal aid at inquests related to major incidents...

bearing_set.reason: Matching 100 criminal law pupillages directly targets criminal justice system capacity — reducing court backlogs and charge/conviction delays, a core O5 indicator ('does justice work?').

Expanding legal aid — including at major-incident inquests — is a due-process and equal-treatment mechanism: it determines whether people can access legal representation and participate fairly in proceedings regardless of means.

membership_note: Two distinct bearings: O5 for the supply-side justice-speed effect (more criminal barristers) and O9 for the access-to-justice/due-process effect (legal aid). Fiscal cost of the pupillage match-funding is modest and incremental relative to existing legal aid budgets, so does not clear the non-negligible bar for O12.
